categories_thin: Water/fire damage restoration: the only Sayreville-address listing found is a single unverified Yellow Pages entry (Statewide Solutions, 449 Washington Rd). The remaining results are out-of-town or national/regional service-area marketers (ServiceMaster, Northeast Power Dry, RDC Restoration, Rescue Titan, AMS), which are not zone businesses under the exclusion rules.

Security/alarm installers: only G. Leff Security Systems has a Sayreville street address, and First Choice Electrical & Security is Sayreville-based with no street address published. Other alarm firms surfaced (Atech Security, BGS Security Division, Select Fire & Security) only advertise service-area coverage with no Sayreville address shown.

Siding/windows: most Sayreville-tagged results are based elsewhere (Window Galaxy USA in South Amboy, Window World of the Jersey Coast in Edison, A&E Exteriors marketing a Sayreville service page). Only Mainstreet Siding and Merino Builders carry Sayreville addresses, and Merino's HIC registration is reported inactive.
Roofing and landscaping are well populated, but many listings are home-based operators with no published address, so several entries carry 'Unknown' addresses and weak single-directory evidence.
caveats: Most large directories (Yellow Pages, Superpages, Manta, BBB, Angi, HomeAdvisor, BuildZoom, Cylex, whereorg) block automated fetching; entries drawn from them rely on search-result snippets and need triage confirmation.

Shared/multi-tenant trade addresses recur: 222 Jernee Mill Rd (Harbor Trucking, Guiliano Environmental, All American Steel, South River Diesel, Roofco in the same block), 776 Jernee Mill Rd (Cardinal Electric, YDH Appliance), 2400 Main St (Advanced Specialty Contractors, G. Leff) and 495 Raritan St (Mattsson's, Just For You, Herbert Moving). Presence at one of these addresses is not by itself proof a firm trades from there.

Businesses commonly described as 'serving Sayreville' but based in Old Bridge, East Brunswick, South Amboy, South River or Monroe were excluded, since the zone is the borough itself. Removed from the earlier list: William Archer & Sons (36 Old Matawan Rd, Old Bridge), Strouse Electric (411 Oak St, South Amboy) and Frank Alvarez & Sons (East Brunswick-based); also removed as unverifiable were 7 Days Garage Door Repair and Appliance Repair Sayreville (lead-generation-style listings) and Bridgeway Key & Lock Repair (single referral-directory listing at a shared address).

Service-area businesses with no published local address (Cecampos Tree & Lawn, Budget Property Maintenance, Barten Bros., Love's Tree Removal, Gregory Locksmith, Top Line Auto Care) are labelled as such in their notes; the triage team should confirm a base town before treating them as zone businesses.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API unreachable from this environment (not retried in this revision).

Google Maps place pages could not be captured as stable per-business URLs, so the ten entries that previously cited generic map-search URLs were re-sourced to own websites or named directory profiles; map-only entries that could not be re-sourced (William Archer & Sons, Frank Alvarez & Sons) were removed.

Licence status could not be checked directly against NJ Division of Consumer Affairs records; where a contractor-profile site reports a lapsed registration (Merino Builders, J.A. Sult) that is noted rather than resolved.
Trading status unresolved for Ron & Jan's Tire & Auto Center (one directory reports closed); no phone calls were made, per the read-only research rules.
The full NJ MVC auto-body roster could not be text-searched reliably for every Sayreville/Parlin facility, so additional licensed body shops may remain unfound.
Phone numbers were not captured for firms whose only evidence is a name-only review profile or single directory listing.
Some listed addresses are residential-style units (home-based trade businesses); only published business addresses are recorded.
Older 'Parlin Discount Tire' and newer 'Mike's Pit Stop' listings share 3143 Bordentown Ave; whether these are the same shop renamed could not be determined from public pages.
